new_page.title: Schools in Delta, BC | Full List by Level | Jared Gibbons
new_page.description: Browse 41 public and independent schools with a Delta address, grouped by level with street addresses. From the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list.

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 41 schools with a Delta street address: 35 public schools and 6 independent schools. It also shows 1 college or university campus. In that list, 10 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 1 Francophone school run by the Conseil scolaire francophone and 2 online schools.

Public schools here are run by School District 37 (Delta) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone). Count by district: School District 37 (Delta): 34, School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone): 1.

The list includes alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address, so the totals run higher than the number of neighbourhood schools; they sit under "other public schools and programs" below. The Ministry's own level field also mislabels some secondary schools as elementary, so this page reads the level from the school's name.

If you are buying with a child in mind, the address matters more than the list. A school's catchment decides which children it must take, and districts change catchments and set their own rules for French immersion and other programs. Ask the district about the exact address before you write an offer.
Delta is one municipality made up of North Delta, Ladner and Tsawwassen, and this list covers all three.

blocks.text: The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 129 licensed childcare facilities with a Delta address: 70 licensed group and 59 licensed family. The registry covers licensed care only. Care that does not need a licence is not listed by address, so a family may find more options than this count suggests. Names and addresses change often, so check the registry before you rely on any one facility.

faq.q: How many schools are in Delta, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 41 schools with a Delta street address: 35 public schools and 6 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.
Public schools with a Delta address are run by School District 37 (Delta) and School District 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone).

faq.q: How do I find which school a home is zoned for?
faq.a: Ask the school district to confirm the catchment school for the exact street address. Catchments change, and living near a school does not guarantee a place at it.
